stories.story_fr: Le chiffre d'affaires a bondi de 90 % d'une année sur l'autre, atteignant un record de 808 M$.
stories.story_en: Revenue grew 90% year over year to a record $808 million.
stories.quote: Revenue grew 90% year over year to a record $808 million.

stories.story_fr: La marge brute s'est améliorée de 540 points de base au cours du trimestre.
stories.story_en: Gross margin improved by 540 basis points on quarter.
stories.quote: gross margin improved by 540 basis points on quarter

stories.story_fr: La marge opérationnelle a progressé de 700 points de base.
stories.story_en: Operating margin improved by 700 basis points.

stories.story_fr: Le carnet de commandes des commutateurs optiques atteint plus de 400 M$.
stories.story_en: Backlog well beyond $400 million for optical circuit switches.

stories.story_fr: Le cash a augmenté de 2 017 M$ grâce à l'émission d'actions privilégiées convertibles de série A.
stories.story_en: Cash rose by $2,017 million from the issuance of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock.
stories.quote: up $2,017.0 million from the end of the second quarter ... due to the proceeds from the issuance of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock
